Here’s to us, and to all the years still waiting for us.

11:
Today felt lighter in the best way. 
Nine hours — from 9 in the morning until 6 in the evening — just hearing your voice, 
and somehow it still didn’t feel like enough. 

I had so much fun with you today. 
Laughing at little things, talking about nothing and everything, 
letting the hours pass without counting them. 
Your voice stayed with me even after we hung up, 
like a quiet warmth I didn’t want to shake off. It reminded me how natural it feels to exist alongside you, 
even from far away. 

Thank you for today. 
Thank you for your voice, your time, and the way you make hours disappear. 

Always, 
King
12:
Today was a quiet one. Not much really happened — 
my teeth hurt most of the day, and everything felt a little slower because of it. 
Still, even on a day like this, your presence made things easier. 
Just having you there, 
talking with you, 
sharing small moments, 
reminded me that comfort doesn’t always come from big events. 
Sometimes it’s simply company. 

Some days don’t need much to be meaningful. 
Today was one of those days — 
and you were the best part of it. 

Always, 
King
13:
Today was loud and full. 
I went out with my cousins to celebrate his birthday, 
and we stayed out all night laughing, eating, just enjoying the moment. 
It was genuinely fun — but even in the middle of all that noise, 
I kept thinking about you. 
I missed you the whole time. 

It’s funny how even when I’m surrounded by people, 
my heart still looks for you. 
I caught myself wishing I could tell you every little detail as it happened, 
wishing you were there in some way. 
Days like this remind me that no matter where I am or what I’m doing, 
you’re always with me — quietly, constantly, naturally.
14:
Today wasn’t perfect, 
and that’s okay. We had a small argument about our relationship, 
and for a moment it felt heavy. 
But what mattered most to me was that we didn’t run from it. 
We talked it through, listened to each other, 
and chose understanding over silence. 
I’m really grateful for that — for us. 
For the way we face things instead of letting them break us. 

After that, we spent the whole day calling, 
just staying connected, 
letting the tension soften into comfort. 
By the end of it, I felt closer to you than before. 
Days like this remind me that love isn’t about never arguing — 
it’s about choosing each other even when things aren’t easy.
15:
Today was simple and really happy. 
We called all day, and I had so much fun just asking you questions — 
the random ones, the curious ones, 
the ones that made me feel closer to you with every answer. 
I love learning you like that, little by little, 
in ways that feel natural and unforced. 

You needed to sleep early tonight, so we ended the day with a sleep call. 
There was something really comforting about that — 
knowing we were resting at the same time, even from far away. 
It felt peaceful, like ending the day exactly where I wanted to be: 
with you.

17:
Today was one of those days I wish I could pause. 
We called for a long time, and I genuinely enjoyed every second of it — 
from the funny questions that made us laugh to the deeper ones about the future, and everything in between. 
It felt easy, natural, and comforting. 

I love how we can move between laughter and seriousness without effort, 
how talking to you never feels like time wasted. 
Days like this remind me how much I love simply being with you :(,

18:
Today was one of those days I’ll probably remember without even trying. 
I woke up early in the morning and called my baby, 
and right away the day felt right. 
We talked about everything and nothing at the same time — 
so much that I honestly can’t even remember what we talked about anymore. 
All I know is that it felt good. 
Time moves differently when I’m talking to you. 
Four hours passed just like that, without me even noticing. 

Later, I went out with my friends and we went to the beach. 
I had so much fun — 
the sun, 
the road, 
riding my motorcycle, 
feeling free for a moment. 
And yet, the whole time, 
I kept wishing you were there with us. 
I kept imagining what it would be like if you were beside me, 
laughing, sharing the view, 
being part of the memory instead of just the thought behind it. 

When I got home, we called again. 
And honestly… of all the calls we’ve ever had, that one was my favorite. 

I finally let myself say what I’ve been feeling lately — 
how full my heart is, how overwhelming it can get, 
how loving you so much sometimes affects me in ways I didn’t even know were possible. 
I didn’t know I was capable of loving someone this deeply. 
I didn’t know love could feel this full, 
this heavy, 
this real. 

But here I am. Loving you. 
And even when it’s intense, even when it scares me a little, 
I wouldn’t trade it for anything. 

Today reminded me that no matter where I go or what I do, 
my favorite place is always with you.
19:
Today was one of those slow, ordinary days. 
I went to school and somehow ended up stuck in the longest line I’ve ever seen just to get my clearance signed. 
A lot of waiting, 
a lot of standing still, 
a lot of time to think. 

And in all that waiting, 
I found myself thinking about you — like I always do. 
Every day, 
I wish I could see you, be with you, 
share even the boring parts of life side by side. 
Lately, I’ve been yearning for you in a quiet but constant way, 
the kind that sits in my chest and doesn’t really leave. 

Nothing big happened today, 
but the wanting stayed. 
I miss you. I miss us. 
And I can’t wait for the day when waiting won’t be the only thing I’m doing — 
when I finally get to hold you instead. 

I love you so much baba.

We called in the morning, and even knowing I had to go to school later, 
it made the day feel lighter. 
While I was there, 
all I really wanted was to finish everything as fast as I could so I could go home to my baby and hear you again. 

I made sure to get everything done, 
and thankfully, I did. 
Going home knowing I’d get to call you again felt like a reward. 
We ended up calling all day, just enjoying each other’s company, 
laughing, 
talking, 
being us. And that time before you fell asleep… yeah, that was my favorite part (wink wink) 

Everything felt playful, warm, and so us. 
Days like this remind me how much joy you bring into my life just by being there, 
just by choosing me the same way I choose you.
21:
My love,

Before anything else, I need to say this properly.

I’m really sorry for how I acted earlier. I know I came off rude and mean, and you didn’t deserve that from me. I let my emotions speak before my understanding did, and I regret that.

When I woke up and saw your message saying you were going out, I was already feeling upset and vulnerable. Instead of asking calmly or telling you how I felt, I assumed things and let that frustration build up inside me. I didn’t say good morning, I didn’t tell you I was awake the whole time, and when we talked, I let that bottled-up feeling come out in my tone. That’s on me.

When I fired back about you not saying anything after “I’m going out,” I wasn’t trying to communicate — I was reacting. I spoke from hurt instead of care, and I understand why that escalated things. I can see now how it made you feel like I was blaming you, when I should’ve just been honest about what was going on in my head.

I want you to know that I wasn’t trying to pick a fight or make you feel bad. I was upset, yes, but that doesn’t excuse being sharp or dismissive with you. You deserve patience, gentleness, and clarity from me — especially when things are already sensitive.

I’m sorry for not saying good morning. I’m sorry for not telling you I was awake. And I’m sorry for letting my tone hurt you when we finally talked. I should’ve handled that moment with more care, because you matter to me.

I’m still learning how to communicate better when my emotions are loud, but please know that my heart was never against you. I care about you deeply, and I hate knowing that my words or tone made you feel otherwise.

Thank you for still talking to me, for listening, and for trying to understand me even when things got messy. I promise to do better — to speak softer, to ask instead of assume, and to remember that we’re on the same side. 

And also I want to speak gently to your heart, because I know it’s been heavy. I know there are moments when you look at us and wonder if you’re enough, or if you’re failing me in some way. I need you to hear this clearly, without doubt or hesitation:

You are not failing me. Not even close.

I don’t love you for what you can give me, or for how much effort you manage to show, or for how perfectly you express your love. I don’t love you for consistency, productivity, reassurance, or sacrifice. I love you for who you are — the person you are when you laugh, when you’re quiet, when you’re unsure, when you’re tired, when you’re simply being yourself. That version of you is the one I chose, and the one I continue to choose every day.

If there are times when it feels like I’m giving more, please don’t see that as a burden you need to carry. I’m not keeping score. I’m not waiting for you to repay me or catch up. I give because loving you comes naturally to me. It’s not a chore, and it’s not something I do out of obligation. I do it because my heart wants to, because you matter to me, because choosing you feels right.

I know you worry that you can’t give me what I deserve. But love isn’t about deserving or earning — it’s about choosing, staying, and growing together. We love differently, and that doesn’t mean one love is stronger or weaker than the other. It just means we are two different people learning how to meet each other where we are.

I don’t want perfection from you. I don’t want you to stretch yourself thin trying to be something you think I need. I want you — honest, imperfect, real. I want the quiet moments, the misunderstandings we learn from, the days when things feel easy and the days when they don’t. All of it belongs to us.

Everything is okay, my love. We are okay. Even when things feel messy or unclear, even when emotions run high, I’m still here. I’m not holding your love against you, and I’m not measuring your worth by what you can give me. My heart is calm with you, even when the world feels loud.

So please don’t carry the fear that you’re not enough. You don’t need to be more, or do more, or try harder just to be loved by me. You already are enough — exactly as you are, exactly where you are.

I’m here because I want to be. I stay because I choose you. Always.

Always yours,
King
